verdict.rationale: Paxos has a dedicated Payments API documented to accept PYUSD/USDC/USDP on-chain transfers, auto-convert to fiat or hold in stablecoin, settle to bank, issue refunds, and receive async settlement confirmation via webhooks — covering create/present/confirm end-to-end. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on developer integration report, no OpenAPI spec exposed (404s), and no explicit example of presenting a checkout address/UI flow to an end customer.
